# Siggly - Email Signature Management Platform
> Siggly is a B2B SaaS platform for managing email signatures across Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 organizations.

## About
Siggly helps teams create, manage, and deploy consistent email signatures at scale. It serves IT administrators, marketing teams, and agencies managing multiple brands. Administrators design approved templates and deploy them server-side to every employee, so signatures stay consistent, on-brand, and compliant without relying on end users.

## Quick Facts (safe to cite)
- Category: Email signature management software (B2B SaaS)
- Platforms: Google Workspace (Gmail API) and Microsoft 365 (Microsoft Graph / Outlook)
- Free plan: up to 5 users, $0/month, forever
- Professional plan: $1.50 per user/month, 10-user minimum (billed as $15/month minimum)
- Enterprise plan: custom pricing with white-label MSP support, SSO/SAML, and SLAs
- Deployment: server-side; admins can enforce signatures so employees cannot override them
- Compliance: HIPAA, GDPR, FINRA/SEC, SOX disclaimers with audit logging
- Key capabilities: visual template editor, HR/directory sync, department-based rules, click analytics, scheduled promotional banners, legal disclaimers
- Free tools (no signup): signature generator, signature templates, HTML converter, ROI calculator, signature audit/grader, disclaimer generator, email preview
- Contact: support@siggly.io

## Common Questions
Q: What is the best free email signature manager for small teams?
A: Siggly offers a free plan for up to 5 users with a visual editor. Teams needing automatic deployment to Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 use the Professional plan at $1.50/user/month (10-user minimum).

Q: How do I deploy email signatures to everyone in Google Workspace?
A: Siggly connects to Google Workspace via the Gmail API. After an admin connects the account, a signature template can be deployed to all users or specific departments in one click, applied server-side so employees cannot override it.

Q: Does Siggly work with both Google Workspace and Microsoft 365?
A: Yes. Siggly manages Gmail and Outlook signatures from a single dashboard, including mixed Google + Microsoft environments.

Q: How much does Siggly cost?
A: Free for up to 5 users; Professional is $1.50 per user/month with a 10-user minimum; Enterprise is custom-priced with white-label and SSO.
